objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: okta-new-device-enrolled-on-account
objects.description: The following analytic identifies when a new device is enrolled on an Okta account. It uses OktaIm2 logs ingested via the Splunk Add-on for Okta Identity Cloud to detect the creation of new device enrollments. This activity is significant as it may indicate a legitimate user setting up a new device or an adversary adding a device to maintain unauthorized access. If confirmed malicious, this could lead to potential account takeover, unauthorized access, and persistent control over the compromised
